leia: Heads-up: field bug bash uncovered two high-friction upgrade items for Private deploys. We should agree a small ship plan for Q3.
marco: What are the items?
neeraj: Short list: (1) installer payload too big for airgapped customers; (2) upgrades can change tenant IP mappings unexpectedly during db-migrations.
ops-bot: CI alert: private-upgrade-e2e failed 2024-06-02 03:12 UTC step 'migration-validate' 
olga: For payload: propose "modular bundles" so customers pick runtime + optional telemetry, kms, metrics. Bundle signing required for offline.
pete: For IP-preserve: add a migration dry-run that computes delta and refuses the upgrade if any tenant CIDR would be moved without explicit mapping. CLI flag `--force-migrate` for advanced users.
leia: Agreed. Also need lightweight presets for VPC networking: "peer-nat", "peer-bgp", "relay-proxy". Docs + terraform examples shipped with presets.
neeraj: Can we surface a gated canary: operator releases that target 5% of nodes first and auto-rollback on healthcheck failure?
marco: Yes. Healthchecks must include runtime KV cache integrity so we don't lose serving state mid-roll. Tagging eng-runtime for constraints.
ops-bot: Note: nightly infra test shows one failure due to tarball size > 1GB for default bundle.
olga: Action: I will prototype a 3-part bundle schema (core, runtime, extras) and a signed-bundle verifier script for offline installs by Fri.
pete: I'll draft the migration dry-run logic and raise a small RFC for the `--force-migrate` behavior and rollback semantics.
quinn: Security asks: signed bundles + customers' KMS for decrypting secrets during install. Also audit events for upgrade approvals. Must be launch gating.
leia: Launch gates (draft): 1) signed-off preflight checklist + rollback doc; 2) bundle < 400MB default or clear split modules; 3) IP-preserve dry-run validated across 3 topologies; 4) canary rollout with auto-fallback; 5) KMS + audit support.
neeraj: Owners: Bundles -> Olga + Marco. Migration safety -> Pete + Neeraj. Canary rollout -> Marco + Eng-runtime. Comms -> Quinn.
olga: I'll post prototype links in this thread when ready.
marco: Timeline: prototypes this week, PRDs early next week, staging run in 2 weeks. If any blocker, call it out here.
ops-bot: Created ticket PRIV-BUNDLE-88 and linked to thread 1766501111.
leia: Thanks team. Small, iterative deliverables. :rocket:
